headline: Safe parking pilot site needs about five more months

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meeting.voteItem: Designating the contractor's principal as a resource
meeting.summary: The committee heard the Safe Parking Pilot site needs about five months of work, and it deferred the item.
meeting.recap: The department director said the contract went to a company that proposed private land at 21 Hanson Road.[[0:15:00]] A notice to proceed, the go-ahead to start work, was issued December 11th, 2025.[[0:15:29]] An extra $162,500 the council approved will go unspent because the contract was not changed.[[0:15:52]] Heavy flooding crossed the site, so the department is re-checking whether people could safely get out.[[0:17:30]] The director estimated about five months to get the site ready.[[0:19:20]] A testifier asked the county to cut through bureaucracy and act with more urgency.[[0:36:54]] The founder of the group that first proposed safe parking said this is a completely different project.[[0:45:33]] The director said the department is looking at undeveloped county-owned land, mostly in central Maui.[[1:08:27]] The director said none of the project money has been spent yet.[[1:33:45]] The director said the department does not yet have an overall homelessness plan but is working on one.[[1:52:36]] The chair said another presentation is planned for July 27.[[1:56:06]] The committee deferred the item, meaning it was held for a later meeting.[[2:03:15]]
decided: Members agreed without objection to make the contractor's principal a resource for questions.
meeting.next: Topographic mapping, a survey of the land's shape, is expected to take about four weeks. The department is talking with county lawyers and finance about its contracting options. The director said she would like to bring church and faith groups together again. The chair said the committee will send a letter to the homeless coordinator asking for an update.

moments.q: Director begins Safe Parking Pilot update
"Does the department have a plan right now? No. We are working on it."
